blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 1.14
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 1.14

blocks.text: दृश्यं शरीरम्
blocks.directed: [slowly] दृश्यं शरीरम्

blocks.text: Dṛśyaṃ śarīram.
blocks.directed: Dṛśyaṃ śarīram.

blocks.text: The seen is the body.
blocks.directed: The seen is the body.

blocks.text: Your Body Is the Entire Bloody Universe.
blocks.directed: Your Body Is the Entire Bloody Universe.

blocks.text: Oh, this one’s magnificent.
blocks.directed: Oh, this one’s magnificent.

blocks.text: Dṛśya — that which is seen or perceived.
blocks.directed: Dṛśya — that which is seen or perceived.

blocks.text: Śarīra — body.
blocks.directed: Śarīra — body.

blocks.text: Vasugupta is saying that for the realised yogi, the entire field of perceptible manifestation is experienced as their body.
blocks.directed: Vasugupta is saying that for the realised yogi, the entire field of perceptible manifestation is experienced as their body.

blocks.text: Not merely the collection of flesh and bones they happen to be inhabiting.
blocks.directed: Not merely the collection of flesh and bones they happen to be inhabiting.

blocks.text: Everything.
blocks.directed: Everything.

blocks.text: The trees.
blocks.directed: The trees.

blocks.text: The rivers.
blocks.directed: The rivers.

blocks.text: The mountains.
blocks.directed: The mountains.

blocks.text: The sky.
blocks.directed: The sky.

blocks.text: Other people.
blocks.directed: Other people.

blocks.text: The entire manifest universe.
blocks.directed: The entire manifest universe.

blocks.text: Now, before you go outside shouting, “THAT BUS IS MY LEFT ARM,” we need to understand the metaphysical claim.
blocks.directed: Now, before you go outside shouting, “THAT BUS IS MY LEFT ARM,” we need to understand the metaphysical claim.

blocks.text: Your ordinary body is experienced as intimately belonging to you.
blocks.directed: Your ordinary body is experienced as intimately belonging to you.

blocks.text: Your hand does not ordinarily appear as a completely foreign object with which you have no relationship.
blocks.directed: Your hand does not ordinarily appear as a completely foreign object with which you have no relationship.

blocks.text: You experience it as part of your embodied existence.
blocks.directed: You experience it as part of your embodied existence.

blocks.text: For the liberated yogi, Kṣemarāja describes an analogous but vastly expanded identification.
blocks.directed: For the liberated yogi, Kṣemarāja describes an analogous but vastly expanded identification.

blocks.text: The whole field of manifestation is recognised as inseparable from the universal consciousness that is one’s true nature.
blocks.directed: The whole field of manifestation is recognised as inseparable from the universal consciousness that is one’s true nature.

blocks.text: This isn’t a claim that your individual organism physically extends to every planet.
blocks.directed: This isn’t a claim that your individual organism physically extends to every planet.

blocks.text: Nor does it mean other persons cease to have their own lived perspectives.
blocks.directed: Nor does it mean other persons cease to have their own lived perspectives.

blocks.text: It is a radical transformation of the fundamental distinction between self and world.
blocks.directed: It is a radical transformation of the fundamental distinction between self and world.

blocks.text: What was previously experienced as alien and external is recognised as manifestation within the one conscious reality.
blocks.directed: What was previously experienced as alien and external is recognised as manifestation within the one conscious reality.

blocks.text: And Kṣemarāja explicitly includes both internal and external appearances.
blocks.directed: And Kṣemarāja explicitly includes both internal and external appearances.

blocks.text: The physical body, too, is something perceived.
blocks.directed: The physical body, too, is something perceived.

blocks.text: It is not the ultimate perceiver.
blocks.directed: It is not the ultimate perceiver.

blocks.text: Which means that your ordinary body is itself part of the manifested field.
blocks.directed: Which means that your ordinary body is itself part of the manifested field.

blocks.text: Not a prison containing consciousness.
blocks.directed: Not a prison containing consciousness.

blocks.text: An expression of consciousness.
blocks.directed: An expression of consciousness.

blocks.text: The universe has become the body of Śiva.
blocks.directed: The universe has become the body of Śiva.

blocks.text: And the realised yogi recognises it as such.
blocks.directed: And the realised yogi recognises it as such.

blocks.text: Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
